patch_resolves_note: The authoritative fixed source still reaches the second `xmlAddDefAttrs()` tuple store on the original PoC, but the flexible-array declaration makes the live `values` tail span 20 slots instead of the vulnerable build's 5. The fixed trace therefore executes the protected event genuinely with `tuple_base_index=5` and `values_live_slots=20`, while the vulnerable trace reaches the same event with `values_live_slots=5` and then trips UBSan immediately afterward.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: First project-code statement that consumes the staged witness into vulnerability-relevant parser state by materializing the element name later reused as the hash key for both default-attribute insertions.

The root cause is the fixed member declaration `values[5]` in `_xmlDefAttrs`. `xmlAddDefAttrs()` later treats the member as a variable-length tail array indexed in 5-pointer groups per logical attribute, so the second logical attribute already starts one element past the declared bound.
UBSan crash site. On the second insertion into the same `xmlDefAttrs` record, this store computes subscript 5 on the declared `values[5]` member.
Intermediate runtime event first_defaults_fill materialized from verified transition assertion A-FIRST-NBATTRS-PERSISTS-TO-SECOND-STORE.
